# GASMIND AI — Technical Architecture & Complete Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive technical specification, data models, state management, and simulation physics for GASMIND AI (Tata Steel Industrial Gas Network Command Center).

---

## 1. System Overview & Technology Stack

GASMIND AI is built with modern, high-performance web standards:
- **Framework**: React 18.2 + TypeScript 5.3
- **Build Engine**: Vite 6.2
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 3.4 with custom dark industrial palette (`#0A0A0B`, `#18181B`, `#27272A`)
- **Data Visualization**: Chart.js 4.4 + React-ChartJS-2 5.2
- **PDF Vector Engine**: jsPDF 4.2 + jspdf-autotable 5.0
- **Audio Synthesis**: Pure HTML5 Web Audio API (Synthesized dual-tone & triple-tone alarms)
- **State Management**: Centralized React Context (`GasDataContext`) with real-time telemetry animation loops and hash-synchronization.

---

## 2. Telemetry Equipment & Data Schema

### 2.1 Gas Generators (Sources)
- **Blast Furnace I (`bf-i`)**: 465,000 Nm³/h @ 14.8 kPa (Net: 271k Nm³/h)
- **Blast Furnace H (`bf-h`)**: 450,000 Nm³/h @ 14.5 kPa (Net: 335k Nm³/h)
- **Blast Furnace G (`bf-g`)**: 322,000 Nm³/h @ 14.2 kPa (Net: 232k Nm³/h)
- **Blast Furnace F (`bf-f`)**: 240,000 Nm³/h @ 13.9 kPa
- **Blast Furnace C (`bf-c`)**: 162,000 Nm³/h @ 13.8 kPa
- **Blast Furnace E (`bf-e`)**: 82,200 Nm³/h @ 13.5 kPa
- **Old Coke Battery 8 & 9 (`co-old`)**: 62,000 Nm³/h CO Gas @ 29.0 kPa
- **New Coke Battery 10 & 11 (`co-new`)**: 80,000 Nm³/h CO Gas @ 28.5 kPa

### 2.2 Industrial Consumers (Sinks)
- **Power House #6 (`ph6`)**: Consumes 300,000 Nm³/h BF Gas + 3,000 Nm³/h CO Gas
- **Coke Plant Underfiring (`coke-plant`)**: Consumes 270,000 Nm³/h BF Gas
- **Power House #3 (`ph3`)**: Consumes 190,000 Nm³/h BF Gas + 1,100 Nm³/h CO Gas
- **Power House #4 (`ph4`)**: Consumes 150,000 Nm³/h BF Gas + 22,000 Nm³/h CO Gas
- **Power House #5 (`ph5`)**: Consumes 130,000 Nm³/h BF Gas + 2,000 Nm³/h CO Gas
- **HSM Reheating Mill (`hsm`)**: Consumes 75,000 Nm³/h BF Gas + 30,000 Nm³/h CO Gas
- **Pelletizing Plant (`pellet`)**: Consumes 60,000 Nm³/h BF Gas + 18,000 Nm³/h CO Gas

---

## 3. Simulation & Redistribution Physics

The simulation engine calculates gasholder depletion windows when generator outages occur:
$$\text{Depletion Time (hours)} = \frac{\text{Current Stock Volume }(m^3)}{\text{Net Volumetric Deficit }(\text{Nm}^3/\text{h})}$$

When a generator fails:
1. Volumetric deficit is recalculated instantaneously across the network.
2. Gasholder level drawdown rate is projected.
3. Priority-based load shedding recommendations are generated:
   - Tier 1 (High Priority): Coke Oven Battery Heating (Must preserve refractory integrity).
   - Tier 2 (Medium Priority): Power Houses (Load shift to alternate boilers or dual-fuel co-firing).
   - Tier 3 (Flexible): Reheating mills (HSM / Pellet plant buffer throttling).

---

## 4. API & Client Routing Architecture

The application uses hash-based client routing with native browser history synchronization:
- `#overview` -> Dashboard view
- `#generation` -> Generator telemetry
- `#consumption` -> Consumer demand view
- `#balance` -> Gas balance & gasholder inventory
- `#network` -> Sankey flow diagram
- `#simulation` -> Sandbox workspace
- `#scenario` -> Multi-dimensional scenario comparison
- `#alerts` -> Operational alarms
- `#timeline` -> Incident timeline log
- `#reports` -> PDF/CSV export builder
- `#audit` -> Departmental audit trail register
- `#about` -> System information & developer specs
